page_title: FRO 2-1 VER | Frosinone v Verona 08/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Verona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90+8' Filippo Terracciano (Verona) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The ball goes out of play. Verona are awarded a corner kick.
90+6' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Maria Caputi signals that the goal stands! The Verona players celebrate.
90+5' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Verona can stand using VAR.

90+4' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Milan Djuric (Verona) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Jackson Tchatchoua and scores magnificently from close range into the right side of the goal. 2:1.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luca Mazzitelli departs the field of play to be replaced by Pol Lirola (Frosinone).
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Substitution. Matias Soule is replaced by Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone).
90' Good movement by Filippo Terracciano (Verona), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
83' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) is substituted due to injury. Eusebio Di Francesco gives a chance to Mehdi Bourabia.
83' Marco Baroni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) replacing Darko Lazovic.
82' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
79' Yellow card. Tomas Suslov (Verona) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
77' The manager makes a subsitution with Federico Bonazzoli (Verona) coming on for Cyril Ngonge.
77' Here is a change. Luca Garritano is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Marco Brescianini (Frosinone).
76' The referee allows time for a substitution. Reinier will be replaced by Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone).
74' The possession of the ball – 57:43.
68' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
66' 2 - 0 Matias Soule (Frosinone) gets on the end of a cross and scores with a fine header that goes inside the right post!
65' The corner is swung in but Verona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
65' A cross from Darko Lazovic (Verona) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball goes out of play. Verona are awarded a corner kick.
61' Matias Soule (Frosinone) fires a shot from close range, but he is somehow only able to hit the right post!
61' Suat Serdar (Verona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ondrej Duda.
60' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Diego Coppola and he is replaced by Davide Faraoni (Verona).
60' We are about to witness a substitution. Milan Djuric (Verona) is replacing Riccardo Saponara.
57' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
52' Filippo Terracciano (Verona) launches himself at a lofted pass, but his close-range header flies just wide of the left post.
49' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.
47' Darko Lazovic (Verona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Stefano Turati intercepts the ball.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
45+1' 1 - 0 Goal! Reinier (Frosinone) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:0.
45+1' OFF THE POST! Stefano Turati (Frosinone) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot which smashes against the right post.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

44' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) was the quickest one to orientate himself inside the box and leaps to connect with a cross from the corner kick. He produces a fine header, but it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
43' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Verona.
43' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Verona have been awarded a corner kick.
42' Verona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
42' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender. Verona will take a corner kick.
40' Bruno Amione (Verona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
39' It must be a yellow card. It is. Ondrej Duda (Verona) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
39' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:1.
36' Matias Soule (Frosinone) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
35' Riccardo Marchizza (Frosinone) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way. Frosinone force a corner. They send men into the box.
35' Matias Soule (Frosinone) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
35' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The linesman makes the right call and Frosinone will have a corner.
34' Matias Soule (Frosinone) muscles his way past two defenders but his shot from inside the box smashes against the left post!
32' Matias Soule (Frosinone) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies high over the bar.
32' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
30' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
30' Caleb Okoli (Frosinone) has tested the patience of referee Maria Caputi and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
29' Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) has a go from distance but he can't find the target as it goes well wide of the left post.
28' Maria Caputi shows a yellow card to Diego Coppola (Verona) for his blatant foul.
25' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
22' Bruno Amione (Verona) is able to continue to play.
21' The game is interrupted now, Bruno Amione (Verona) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
16' Filippo Terracciano (Verona) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
10' The Verona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
8' Matias Soule (Frosinone) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.

3' Matias Soule (Frosinone) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies inches over the crossbar.
3' Dangerous play by Ondrej Duda (Verona). Maria Caputi blows his whistle for a foul.

The players are on the pitch and Frosinone will have the kick-off.
